info.name: DigifyHR Compensation Pay Run Details
info.description:
Read-only APIs over COMP.V_COMP_PAY_RUN_DETAILS.

Base path: {{baseUrl}}/api/comp
Auth: Bearer {{jwt}}

All requests require enterprise_id (tenant isolation).
List: GET /pay-runs. Optional employee_id filters line-level endpoints.
Pagination: page (default 1), limit (default 50, max 100).

request.description:
One header record per pay run for the enterprise.

Example success:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [{
    "payRunId": 103,
    "enterpriseId": 1,
    "planId": 111,
    "runType": "PAYROLL",
    "runStatus": "COMPLETED",
    "processPeriod": "AUGUST 2026",
    "totalSelected": 9,
    "totalProcessed": 9,
    "totalFailed": 0
  }],
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "total": 1, "total_pages": 1, "has_next": false, "has_previous": false }
}

item.name: Get pay run details for one employee
Get employees processed in a pay run
